name: @slopperday/promo
description: Slopper's promo video, made with Remotion.

scripts.render: remotion render src/index.ts vision-portrait out/slopper-promo.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --audio-bitrate 192k --concurrency 50%
scripts.render:landscape: remotion render src/index.ts vision-landscape out/slopper-promo-landscape.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 20 --audio-bitrate 192k --concurrency 50%
